content:
Long before the iPod existed, the Sony Walkman was already the go-to choice for anyone who wanted to add a soundtrack to their life. Now there's a Duo-Man app that brings that experience back for those of us who once owned one — and you can use it with Apple Music…

Before the Walkman, if you wanted to listen to music on the go, your options were pretty limited. Most cassette players at the time were heavy and bulky. Sony shrunk down a recorder originally designed for journalists into the smallest cassette player around, and it quickly became a classic.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created the app at a hackathon — and because so many people there had never seen a Walkman in person, he brought a real one along to show them what it looked like.

You open Duo, pick the album "cassette" you want to insert, close it, and it starts playing.

Bhargava says he originally built it just as a fun demo app, but is now formally releasing it as a real application. The best reply in the X thread is this one — an image that only a certain generation will understand.

What was the first music player you ever owned? Share it in the comments.
